entity_types.name: Organization
entity_types.description: Corporate or non-governmental actor influencing AI capex and power supply

attributes.name: sector
attributes.description: Industry sector (cloud, power equipment, utility, AI lab, finance)

attributes.name: influence_tier
attributes.description: High/medium/low influence on the 2027 forecast outcome

attributes.name: capex_posture
attributes.description: Expanding / plateau / cutting stance on 2027 capacity buildout

entity_types.selection_rule: Non-government organization that is not a hyperscaler, grid operator, utility or equipment supplier but whose actions causally affect 2027 capex, demand or interconnection outcomes.

entity_types.name: Government
entity_types.description: Government body, regulator or statistical agency shaping grid rules and demand outlooks
entity_types.selection_rule: Any governmental body that issues binding interconnection rules, orders pauses, or publishes the settling demand outlook series.
anti_examples: IEA (intergovernmental outlook publisher, better typed OutlookAgency)

entity_types.name: Hyperscaler
entity_types.description: Big-four cloud/AI platform firm whose combined capex is the forecast target

attributes.name: capex_2027_consensus_usd_bn
attributes.description: 2027 analyst consensus capex in USD billions

attributes.name: financing_mix
attributes.description: Cash flow / bond / SPV off-balance-sheet funding approach

entity_types.selection_rule: One of the four firms (Amazon, Microsoft, Alphabet, Meta) whose calendar-year combined capex defines the forecast variable.
levers: Raise or cut capex guidance on earnings calls
Issue bonds or SPV debt for datacenters

entity_types.name: GridOperator
entity_types.description: Regional transmission organization managing interconnection queues and load rules

attributes.name: region
attributes.description: Served market region (PJM Mid-Atlantic, ERCOT Texas, etc.)

attributes.name: queue_status
attributes.description: State of interconnection queue and large-load vetting rules

entity_types.selection_rule: RTO/ISO that operates the transmission queue and large-load interconnection protocols determining whether planned 2027 capacity slips.

entity_types.name: ElectricUtility
entity_types.description: Regulated utility serving major datacenter load pockets

attributes.name: contracted_dc_pipeline_gw
attributes.description: Contracted datacenter capacity pipeline in GW

entity_types.selection_rule: Regulated utility delivering power to datacenter clusters whose conversion pace signals whether capacity energizes on time.
levers: Vet or defer datacenter delivery-point requests

entity_types.name: PowerEquipmentSupplier
entity_types.description: Supplier of gas turbines, transformers and grid equipment gating buildout

attributes.name: backlog_status
attributes.description: Contracted backlog and slot reservation status (GW, USD)

attributes.name: lead_time
attributes.description: Typical delivery lead time for key equipment

entity_types.selection_rule: Hardware supplier whose delivery slots and lead times physically gate whether 2027 datacenter capacity energizes on schedule.
anti_examples: Chevron (fuel partner, low causal role unless contracted)

entity_types.name: OutlookAgency
entity_types.description: Intergovernmental forecasting agency publishing reference demand outlooks

attributes.name: series_role
attributes.description: Whether its series settles or informs the forecast

entity_types.selection_rule: Intergovernmental agency whose published TWh path anchors the global >20% growth question.
entity_types.selection_note: Passive outlook publisher; informs rather than decides.

entity_types.name: DatacenterAsset
entity_types.description: Trackable datacenter campus or capacity pipeline object

attributes.name: capacity_gw
attributes.description: Planned or contracted capacity in GW

attributes.name: power_arrangement
attributes.description: Grid, behind-the-meter, PPA or co-located generation

entity_types.selection_rule: Named datacenter campus or aggregated capacity pipeline whose energization timing resolves the >5 GW delay question.

entity_types.name: MacroeconomicIndicator
entity_types.description: Official demand or GDP series used as forecast baseline signal
entity_types.selection_rule: Numeric official series tracked as leading indicator for the demand-growth question.
anti_examples: Press tallies of capex (claim, not series)

edge_types.name: COMPETES_WITH
edge_types.description: Rivalry between hyperscalers for AI capacity and cloud share
edge_types.direction_semantics: Source competes head-to-head with target in AI/cloud capacity buildout; symmetric rivalry.

edge_types.name: SUPPLIES
edge_types.description: Supply of GPUs, turbines, transformers or nuclear power to buyers

attributes.name: good_supplied
attributes.description: GPUs / gas turbines / transformers / nuclear power

attributes.name: contract_volume
attributes.description: GW or USD volume of contract

edge_types.direction_semantics: Source supplies equipment or power to target; supply tightness constrains target's 2027 buildout.

edge_types.name: DEPENDS_ON
edge_types.description: Dependency on a bottleneck supplier, grid or capacity provider
edge_types.direction_semantics: Source's buildout depends on target's capacity/queue; target is the potential bottleneck.

edge_types.name: REGULATES
edge_types.description: Regulatory authority over grid operators and interconnection rules
edge_types.direction_semantics: Source regulates target's interconnection protocols and large-load rules.

edge_types.name: INFLUENCES
edge_types.description: Shaping of decisions via forecasts, orders or market pressure

attributes.name: channel
attributes.description: Analyst estimate contagion / policy order / outlook revision

edge_types.direction_semantics: Source sways target's guidance, rules or forecasts without formal authority.

edge_types.name: PARTNERS_WITH
edge_types.description: Alliance for power procurement or AI compute buildout

attributes.name: purpose
attributes.description: Nuclear PPA / Stargate buildout / fast gas delivery

edge_types.direction_semantics: Source and target jointly pursue power or compute capacity; symmetric alliance.

edge_types.name: CUSTOMER_OF
edge_types.description: Commercial customer relationship for compute or power
edge_types.direction_semantics: Source buys compute or power from target, underwriting demand.

edge_types.name: PARALLEL_AGENCY_DEMAND_OUTLOOKS
edge_types.description: Cross-referenced demand outlooks between IEA and EIA
edge_types.direction_semantics: Source's outlook series is cross-referenced with target's forecast; both inform the demand question.

edge_types.name: CONSTRAINS
edge_types.description: Causal gating of capex-to-capacity conversion by physical bottlenecks
edge_types.direction_semantics: Source's lead times or queue rules delay target's energization, driving GW slippage.

edge_types.name: ACCELERATES
edge_types.description: Causal enablement of faster buildout via financing or fast-track rules
edge_types.direction_semantics: Source's debt funding, fast-track protocol or fast gas units accelerates target's on-time energization.

analysis_summary: 该预测问题聚焦2027年四大超大规模云厂商合计资本开支（70%置信区间）、全球数据中心用电增速是否超20%、以及美国并网约束导致超过5GW计划产能推迟至2028的概率。领域为AI基础设施投资与电力供应链交叉地带：核心能动主体是四家超大规模厂商（决定capex）、GE Vernova/NVIDIA等设备供应商（涡轮/变压器/GPU交付时滞为物理硬约束）、PJM/ERCOT等电网运营方（并网队列与大负荷规则）、Dominion等受监管公用事业（负荷口袋转化进度）、FERC/EIA等政府机构（规则与预测口径）、以及OpenAI/Oracle/Goldman Sachs等关键利益相关方。本体保留种子类型Organization与Government，并为高频主体新增Hyperscaler、GridOperator、ElectricUtility、PowerEquipmentSupplier等可区分类型；客体侧引入OutlookAgency（IEA路径）、DatacenterAsset（36.3GW管线与命名园区）与MacroeconomicIndicator（EIA/IMF领先指标序列）。关系上保留全部种子边并新增CONSTRAINS/ACCELERATES因果边（带sign/lag/strength），刻画设备交付与并网规则如何把capex传导为实际通电产能——这是三个子问题的共同传导机制。媒体与分析师（Reuters、I/O Fund等）仅作为信息来源，未被实例化为能动主体。
